title: Traffic and health
description: Requests, errors, latency, probes and host health per environment.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Requests in the NGINX access logs of the proxy hosts that ship logs.

targets.expr: _time:5m env:$env server_name:* | stats count() if (status:>=500) e5xx, count() total | math (e5xx / total) * 100 as pct | fields pct
_time:5m env:$env server_name:* | stats quantile(0.95, request_time) p95

panels.title: Probe success
panels.description: Average of the blackbox HTTP probes of the public hostnames, last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Share of proxy connections
panels.description: Established TCP connections on the proxy hosts, as a share per host. Shows where the traffic goes when DNS changes.

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: 2xx, 3xx and 4xx stack. 5xx is drawn on its own from zero, so it does not hide on top of the stack.

targets.expr: env:$env server_name:* | math floor(status / 100) as sc | format "<sc>xx" as class | stats by (class) rate() rps
env:$env server_name:* | stats by (server_name) rate() rps
env:$env server_name:* status:>=500 | stats by (server_name) rate() rps

panels.title: Requests / s by proxy host
panels.description: An even split means the proxies share the load. One host far off the others needs a look.

targets.expr: env:$env server_name:* | stats by (host) rate() rps
env:$env server_name:* | stats quantile(0.5, request_time) p50, quantile(0.95, request_time) p95, quantile(0.99, request_time) p99
env:$env server_name:* | stats by (server_name) quantile(0.95, request_time) p95

panels.title: p95 upstream time by proxy host
panels.description: Time the app servers took to answer, as NGINX saw it.

targets.expr: env:$env server_name:* upstream_response_time:* | stats by (host) quantile(0.95, upstream_response_time) p95

panels.title: Probe time by phase
panels.description: Average over the probed hostnames. A jump in connect or tls points at the network, in processing at the app.

panels.title: Hosts up by role
panels.description: Share of the hosts in each role that answer the scrape.

targets.expr: env:$env server_name:* status:>=500 | stats by (server_name, status, request_uri) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 25

panels.title: Latest 5xx
panels.description: Newest first. The Cloudflare ray ID finds the same request in the Cloudflare dashboard.

targets.expr: env:$env server_name:* status:>=500 | fields _time, host, server_name, status, request_method, request_uri, request_time, http_cf_ray
